title: A Trinuclear EuIII Array within a Diastereoselectively Self-Assembled Helix Formed by Chiral Bipyridine-Carboxylate Ligands

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: trinuclear europium(III) helical array with chiral pinene-bipyridine-carboxylate ligands

synthesis.procedure: Triethylamine (77 μL, 0.53 mmol, 2.3 equiv) was added to (+)-HL·HCl·H2O (80 mg, 0.23 mmol) in MeOH (3 mL). A methanol solution of Eu(ClO4)3·9H2O (0.115 mmol, 0.5 equiv; 1.2 mL of 0.0487 M) was dropped onto the stirring mixture, giving an immediate white precipitate. The solid was collected by filtration, washed with cold MeOH, and dried (82 mg, 83% based on the pentahydrate formulation). Crystals of the trinuclear assembly suitable for X-ray diffraction were grown from MeCN/MeOH.

reagents.name: europium(III) perchlorate nonahydrate
reagents.amount: 0.115 mmol, 0.5 equiv; 1.2 mL of 0.0487 M MeOH solution

synthesis.vessel_or_method: one-pot self-assembly in methanol with stirring; filtration
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: White precipitate collected by filtration, washed with cold MeOH, and dried. Crystals grown from MeCN/MeOH.

properties.summary: The Eu3 array is chiroptically active (CD exciton couplet near 320 nm; [α]D20 = −97.3 deg dm2 mol−1) and shows bright red EuIII luminescence in solution and the solid state (φtotEu = 6.5%, τ = 1.5 ms in MeCN). CPL of the 5D0→7FJ transitions after ligand excitation at 315 nm gives glum = −0.16 at 585 nm for 5D0→7F1.
